title: Practice the Skill You Avoid | David Goggins Commentary
narration: David Goggins describes discipline as something you keep practicing after training ends. Turn that into a practice plan. Pick the skill you usually avoid, work on it for five focused minutes, then write down one thing you learned. Give tomorrow a better starting point.
